name: Beam 1.0 (501B-A23B)
purpose: Open frontier-size model for agentic coding, tool use and reasoning with token-efficient reasoning (about 3x fewer reasoning tokens than leading open models, vendor claim) (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Apache License 2.0 text read in the repo LICENSE file: commercial use, modification and redistribution allowed with notice and patent grant.

architecture.kind: sparse MoE, 3 dense plus 49 MoE layers, gated GQA with sliding window
architecture.attention: gated GQA 48 Q / 8 KV heads plus sliding window 512

variants.notes: UD-IQ2_M about 165, UD-Q2_K_XL about 227, UD-Q4_K_XL about 306, UD-Q6_K_XL about 500, Q8_0 about 650 GB (sums of parts)

pc-12gb.notes: 134 GB file exceeds the 9.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget

pc-16gb.notes: 134 GB file exceeds the 13.6 GB VRAM plus 50 GB RAM budget

pc-24gb.notes: 134 GB file exceeds the 21.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget

pc-32gb.notes: 134 GB file exceeds the 29.6 GB VRAM plus 82 GB RAM budget

mac-16-24gb.notes: 134 GB file against a GPU share of about 12 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-32gb.notes: 134 GB file against a GPU share of about 22 GB (KV cache not included)

mac-64gb+.notes: 134 GB file against a GPU share of about 52 GB (KV cache not included)

engine_support.notes: GGUFs from unsloth, bartowski and others exist.

weaknesses: no quant under 134 GB: out of reach for every hardware class we serve
soft.maturity: 13k downloads, 325 likes; technical report still announced as coming

tona_fit.reason: Frontier size (134 GB at 2 bits, 306 GB at Q4) exceeds every class including the 128 GB RAM PC and 64 GB Macs. Recorded as a reference for what open models reach. Apache-2.0 (text read).
